text: Let's meet the Anaplan Model Knowledge Agent. Getting started is simple.

Before starting the conversation, you only have to select a model at the left, from the ones you have already connected in the connections section of the platform. Once selected, we ask it to generate the test scripts for a UX or a whole Anaplan category. We are asked once whether there's anything particular to consider and whether to keep the default test types or use others.
In seconds, it returns a downloadable Excel with the test cases — and it keeps adding to that same file, one category at a time.

It also answers questions about the model's global backend structure. We can ask which module is referenced the most in the model, what a specific module references or is referenced by, which actions touch a module, or where a module's data ultimately comes from, tracing both formulas and actions. Also, it can generate a dependent tree for module references and build a schema showing references in and out.
And when it's time to document, we can ask it to generate a user guide for a section, or a full training document for the whole model.

The agent generates a knowledge transfer document in chat or Word format with a global architecture overview (purpose, overall architecture, data flows, terminology, rules) generated once per session, plus per-category sections naming the real backend modules and actions behind each page.
Explain, test and document a complete Anaplan model with Anaplan Model Knowledge.
Keyrus AI Studio. All your agents. All your knowledge. One platform. This is only the Beginning.
